title: Reading Drill — Comparing home energy displays — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing home energy displays — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The energy advice team had been asked to investigate residents overlooking changes in daily electricity use in Cairnford. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on the number of changes correctly noticed, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a ten-week comparison, the team used short interviews at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because large differences in billing periods might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward a weekly comparison chart. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
